current_main_fusion.architecture: Canonical UnifiedDB + rebuildable ClayGraph + cheapest validated read primitive + epoch/provenance-bound model-facing possibility/context field.
current_main_fusion.graph_head_law: Strict correctness is always available; derived head compilation is permitted only after strict/head full-row equality, zero same-epoch ambiguity, and positive guarded amortization.

verify and publish revalidate graph-plan bindings

local_logic_falsifiers.ci_note: Earlier stale-branch GitHub-hosted workflow failed before exposing executable steps/logs; treated as infrastructure-red, not code evidence.

web_fusion.sqlite_transaction_result: BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately and prevents a second concurrent writer from entering the verification-to-publication gap; it can return SQLITE_BUSY under contention.
web_fusion.sqlite_busy_policy_result: Do not silently replace the connection-wide busy handler inside the semantic builder; classify busy fail-closed and leave bounded retry/backoff to the continuity layer.
web_fusion.graphrunner_result: External primary research supports separating traversal planning, verification and execution; it is mechanism-direction evidence, not Clay-specific proof.
